* {{ill|Kanasana Shrine (Honjo City, Imai)|ja|金鑽神社 (本庄市今井)}} - Located in {{ill|Imai (disambiguation)|en|Imai (disambiguation)|qid=Q1659666|lt=Imai}}, {{ill|Honjō, Saitama|en|Honjō, Saitama|qid=Q873565|lt=Honjo City}}, {{ill|Saitama Prefecture|en|Saitama Prefecture|qid=Q128186|lt=Saitama Prefecture}}.

* {{ill|Kanasana Shrine|en|Kanasana Shrine|qid=Q11647974|lt=Kanasana Shrine}} - Located in {{ill|Ninomiyama|ja|字二ノ宮}}, {{ill|Kamikawa, Saitama|arz|بلده كاميكاوا, اليابان|ceb|Kamikawa-machi (subdistrito sa Hapon)|de|Kamikawa (Saitama)|es|Kamikawa (Saitama)|fa|کامیکاوا، سایتاما|fr|Kamikawa (Saitama)|id|Kamikawa, Saitama|it|Kamikawa (Saitama)|ja|神川町|ko|가미카와정 (사이타마현)|ms|Kamikawa, Saitama|my|ခမိခါဝါမြို့၊ ဆိုင်းတမ|pl|Kamikawa (Saitama)|ru|Камикава (Сайтама)|sv|Kamikawa, Saitama|tl|Kamikawa, Saitama|tr|Kamikawa, Saitama|uk|Камікава (Сайтама)|ur|کامیکاوا، سائیتاما|zh|神川町|qid=Q1346757|lt=Kamikawa Town}}, {{ill|Kodama District, Saitama|en|Kodama District, Saitama|qid=Q938038|lt=Kodama District}}, Saitama Prefecture.
